bullets.text: In Madipakkam, a youth tragically died after falling into an open drain, and the office should monitor drainage safety measures.
In Tiruttani, an elderly woman died and ten women were injured due to electric shock from a municipal freezer box, and officials must inspect equipment safety.
In Tiruvallur district, mysterious deaths of hundreds of ducks have caused panic, and the administration should investigate potential disease outbreaks immediately.
CMRL issued notice to correct to two contractors for poor progress of Phase-II works along OMR, and the office should track project acceleration.
Residents near the Pallikaranai Ramsar Zone appealed in the High Court to protect one lakh families, and the office should review wetland buffer zone regulations.
Geri Care hosted its 3rd community theatre edition in Velachery with Maadhu Balaji, showcasing local senior care engagement.
In Gummidipoondi, villagers besieged the block development office demanding inclusion in the rural employment scheme, and authorities should address their grievances.
Investors lodged major fraud complaints against Sigaramthodu Chits Private Limited in Tiruvallur, and the district team should assist affected depositors.
The US FDA classified the Caplin Point facility in Gummidipoondi as OAI following an inspection, and officials should monitor compliance updates.
Bodhan AI partnered to train over one million school teachers across India in artificial intelligence, and the portfolio team should explore state collaboration.
Vultr is expanding its operations in India by establishing Chennai as a hub for network engineering and security, aligning with our digital goals.
Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science launched Tamil Nadu's first university-based futures skills center with 15 centers of excellence.
The BJP released an AI-generated video mocking the TVK cabinet using classic movie scenes, highlighting ongoing digital political satire.
Chennai Police registered a case against YouTuber Sattai Duraimurugan over alleged defamatory remarks regarding TVK.
South Korean automotive component makers Hwashin Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa are set to invest Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu.
